messages:
rachel: quick heads-up — onboarding Cust:Citadel finetune (citadel-lora-1.1) on rwd-base-30b-int8 showing a weird token-shift in numeric fields on our invoice set. anyone free to eyeball?
devon: can you share a failing example + command you used?
rachel: ran `./quick_eval --model rwd-base-30b-int8 --adapter citadel-lora-1.1 --evalset citadel_invoices_qp.json --out out.json --batch 16`
rachel: sample failure:
PROMPT: Extract invoice_number and total from the doc.
GOLD: {"invoice_number":"C-994","total":"4500.00"}
OUTPUT: {"invoice_number":"C-994","total":"45 00.00"}  <-- space inserted in middle of number
miguel: that's odd. looks like a token boundary got injected between digits. is this only on int8 or also on fp16?
rachel: fp16 with same adapter yields correct `4500.00`. int8 and int4 both show similar spacing insertion but more pronounced in int4.
arjun: two quick checks: 1) tokenizer mismatch between adapter/training tokenizer and our runtime tokenizer, 2) adaptive vocab merge during LoRA packaging might have introduced stray tokens.
devon: can you dump tokenization for that prompt? use `--debug-tokenized` flag.
rachel: kicked a debug run with `--debug-tokenized --sample-ids 5` and uploaded logs to gs://redwood-evals/citadel/3659991234/debug_tokenized.jsonl
eval-bot: Debug run complete. logs: gs://redwood-evals/citadel/3659991234/debug_tokenized.jsonl :white_check_mark:
miguel: looking at tokenized trace: adapter tokenizer splits `4500.00` -> ["45","00",".00"] whereas base tokenizer expects ["4500",".00"]. IDs: adapter uses id 40123 for "45" and 40124 for "00". base uses 30105 for "4500".
arjun: that explains inserted space. packaging should have included token remap. did packer run `merge_vocab=true`?
rachel: packer logs show `merge_vocab=false` (we left default). the LoRA pack step created a `tokenizer_additions.json` that wasn't remapped to base ids.
devon: immediate fix: run token-id remap utility: `python tools/remap_adapter_tokens.py --adapter citadel-lora-1.1 --base rwd-base-30b --out remapped_adapter.tgz` then redeploy adapter. also add a sanity-check that numeric-only tokens remain single-token where possible.
miguel: i'll run remap and a quick int8 smoke: `./quick_eval --model rwd-base-30b-int8 --adapter remapped_adapter.tgz --evalset citadel_invoices_qp.json --batch 16 --limit 200`
rachel: if remap fixes it, we should add a gating test to our onboarding pipeline: token-id overlap check + numeric-token preservation.
arjun: Agreed. also file a follow-up to update the packer default to `merge_vocab=true` for customer finetunes unless they explicitly opt-out. :memo:
eval-bot: scheduled remap job job_id=citadel-remap-3659993000 and follow-up smoke job job_id=citadel-smoke-3659993200
rachel: thanks team — i'll monitor the smoke results and post back.
